name: Eko Dunung
bio:
Eko Dunung Sutrisno (commonly spelled Eko Dudung Sutrisno) is the real name of the actor who plays Penyok, one of the most popular and versatile comedic characters in the Javanese YouTube series Woko Channel. He is widely celebrated by fans for his incredible acting range and unique comedic style. While his main role is the skinny, easily annoyed character Penyok, he is famous for playing an entire family by himself using camera editing tricks. He plays Penyok’s sick father (Kabul / Mak De Ribut), Penyok's mother (Padas Gempal), his teenage sister (Peni), and a local mechanic (Lek Karni).

Before finding viral YouTube fame, he worked as a professional keyboardist for local dangdut orkes music troupes in Kediri, East Java. When the COVID-19 pandemic halted live entertainment and wedding gigs, he and his fellow musicians focused entirely on creating comedy videos.
